display_name: Penal Law 5737-1977 — robbery (Hebrew-canonical, with English renderings)
scope: Five sections only: 383 (what theft is), 384 (the penalty for theft), 402 (robbery, and aggravated robbery), 403 (assault for the purpose of robbery) and 404 (demanding property by threats). Not the whole Act, which has 651 sections, and not the general part. The module is written in Hebrew -- Hebrew identifiers, Hebrew section titles, and an untagged Hebrew @nlg herald on every rule under a module-level `@lang he` -- with an `@nlg:en` English herald beside each one, so `l4 nlg --lang en` and `l4 render --lang en` produce a whole English document from the same source. Source terms are OPEN and are recorded once at the subject level in ../../source/SOURCE-LICENSE.md. Built to stand beside sg/penal-code-1871's robbery-390-392.l4; NOTES.md carries an element-by-element comparison of the two, marked as an unreviewed reading.
